question: TH Vinayakram, a famous musician, is associated with which musical instrument?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ghatam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Ghatam**

 
 
• A Ghatam is a large, narrow-mouthed earthenware pot used as a percussion instrument.
 
• The ghatam is a percussion instrument that is utilized in several Indian repertoires.
 
• The ghatam is an Indian percussion instrument that dates back thousands of years. It's a narrow-mouthed clay pot.
 
• A small amount of plasticine clay or water can be used to change the pitch significantly.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16ce91c8903f77f0a7d3059a0eca574979fc2791ef6b6e736d431834b45de744.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Mridangam**​​​

 
 
• The mridangam is a percussion instrument of ancient origin.
 
• One of the most ancient drums of India, the mridangam, which literally means 'body of clay,' originated in South India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/556141b52bec994d00221c0f7b5a15369ea88dd74f0d4759954a0588928a955f.png] 

 
• **Sarod**

 
 
• Sarod is a **stringed instrument** made of coconut shell, tun wood, drone, shikri, and ivory.
 
• This is a traditional instrument that is found in various parts of** North India**.
 
• A popular plucked instrument, it is used in North Indian classical music for **solo concerts**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9589ac1f9c24254958172280384c4a47a3759de04a84019ecc19f60dc6d023be.png] 

 
• Tabla

 
 
• Tabla is a small drum or Pair of Drums tuned to different pitches playing with hands.
 
• It was invented by Amir khusru __in 1738.
 
• The right side is called the Tabla and the left, the Bayan or Dagga.
 
• It is a type of Avanaddha vadya or Membranophone.
 
 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/564516f908c253d7f3ee54caeb9c292f8e93455b13dd018819609283a8d9c74a.png]
